name: meet-strangers
description: Anonymous, signup-free random voice/video chat with strangers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @meet-strangers/server" "npm run dev -w @meet-strangers/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @meet-strangers/client && npm run build -w @meet-strangers/server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
